maddeler.e:
نحدودب (form XII)
# نَحْدَوْدِبُ (naḥdawdibu) /naħ.daw.di.bu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِحْدَوْدَبَ (iḥdawdaba)
# نَحْدَوْدِبَ (naḥdawdiba) /naħ.daw.di.ba/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِحْدَوْدَبَ (iḥdawdaba)
# نَحْدَوْدِبْ (naḥdawdib) /naħ.daw.dib/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِحْدَوْدَبَ (iḥdawdaba)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
